m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wow. You don't see something like that every day. I guess that's why it's called the River of Frozen Tears.
No one's been here in a long time. Look at the doors. They're frozen shut. You know, I remember reading something about a ritual here.
I think we have to light a fire in the two braziers to unseal the door. Not much to burn around here though.
Actually, I have an idea. We can gather a couple of the Numbskull Ogres' Clubs and use those for firewood. Don't worry. I got your back.
That should do it. Let's go toss these Clubs into the Braziers and light them up.
Looks like that did the trick. Guess we're going in now. I wonder what we're going to find... you go first.
<ITALICS>The stone chamber appears to be ancient, but it's been immaculately maintained. The air still feels clean and fresh. </ITALICS>
Jehoha'hardiin, children of the new age. In your tongue, I am called Vigilant Perun, and I extend to you the welcome of the Sunless Shrine.
So yeah. I'm just going to hang around here for a while and take it all in. I totally hope you guys have an awesome journey though.
Haha! Yeah. Thanks Zoot. Stay mellow, or whatever. It's really not much farther now to the Sunless Shrine.
Check it out. I think that's the Shrine right there. We just follow the frozen river bed and steer clear of the Numbskull Ogres. Let's go.
Hey! How's it going! Gosh, seems like it's been forever. It hasn't though, has it? Yeah, weren't you on your way to the Sunless Shrine?
